cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
cp runs.json runs_before_reset_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M).json
sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<'P'
import json,time
runs=json.load(open('runs.json'))
tpl=[r for r in runs if r['id']==1][0]
print('шаблон stages:',tpl['cfg']['stages'])
now=int(time.time()*1000)
new=[];i=0
for track,nm in (('me','Мой канал'),('bot','Канал бота')):
    for sym in ('NEARUSDT','SOLUSDT','BTCUSDT','ZECUSDT','BNBUSDT'):
        for tf in ('5m','15m','1h','4h','1d'):
            i+=1
            cfg=json.loads(json.dumps(tpl['cfg'])); cfg['tf']=tf
            if track=='bot':
                st=dict(cfg['stages'][0]); st['t']='tl_both'; cfg['stages']=[st]
            new.append({'id':i,'name':'%s %s %s'%(nm,sym,tf),'sym':sym,'cfg':cfg,'start_ms':now,'stop_ms':None,'trades':None})
json.dump(new,open('runs.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False)
print('создано',len(new))
P
chown tbot:tbot runs.json
for k in 1 2; do S=$(date +%s.%N); curl -s -m 250 localhost:8091/api/runs > /tmp/acc$k.json; E=$(date +%s.%N); echo "запрос $k: $(python3 -c "print(round($E-$S,1))") с"; done
python3 - <<'P'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/acc2.json'))
print('runs',len(d['runs']),'tracks',sorted(set(r['track'] for r in d['runs'])))
for k in ('me','bot','both'):
    a=d['accounts'][k]['account']; print(k,a['equity'],a['taken'],d['accounts'][k]['signals']['n'])
P
journalctl -u classicbot -n 40 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ci "traceback"
